title: Ep 29 — Anthropic gives away a commerce-agent blueprint, and the freelancer bot that hit twenty-five thousand dollars a month
description: Anthropic open-sources a blueprint for AI shopping and merchant agents, Google upgrades its cheapest coding model without raising the price, and xAI opens always-on Grok Bot teammates to the enterprise. Plus a deep dive on the Upwork proposal-writing agent that reportedly hit twenty-five thousand dollars a month, and why a safer, human-in-the-loop version of it could work as sponsorship-outreach software for grassroots clubs and charities.
